body:
Hello, I am trying to take advantage of Intel SVML. However, installing icc_rt by using pip (through PyCharm) does not make numba utilizes it since `numba -s`  says SVML is False as below.  [This instruction](http://numba.pydata.org/numba-doc/latest/user/performance-tips.html#intel-svml) only gives a way to install with conda. Is there any way to do it without conda?
